theme.strategy: Professional Navy-Dominant Career SaaS with Electric Purple & Indigo Accents, crisp high-density cards, tactile telemetry, and clear interview simulation canvases.
theme.emotional_tone: Authoritative, empowering, calm under pressure, rigorously structured for fresh graduates and early career engineers.

typography.font_family_body: Plus Jakarta Sans, 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', sans-serif

entry_surfaces./: Editorial Split Hero — Bold Navy Brand statement with live readiness radar & CTA left, mock interview telemetry simulation right
entry_surfaces./auth/sign-in: Branded Split Auth — Deep Navy career impact panel left, centered high-clarity credentials form right
entry_surfaces./auth/sign-up: Branded Split Auth — Placement readiness value propositions left, step-one student registration form right
entry_surfaces./onboarding: Distraction-free Focused Stepper — Multi-step progressive disclosure card with milestone trail and real-time profile completion score
entry_surfaces./dashboard: High-Density Command Grid — Preparation metric strip top, score trends chart left, weak areas radar and active roadmap right
entry_surfaces./interview: Interactive Audio-Text Simulator — Stage-aware split layout with interviewer prompt top-left, speech/text response editor bottom, real-time rubric guide right

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp slate border (`border-slate-200` on panels, `border-slate-800` on dark canvas)
visual_enhancers.radii: Systematic 8px to 12px nested curves (`rounded-xl` for cards, `rounded-lg` for inner widgets and buttons, `rounded-full` for status pills)
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Subtle card lifts (`hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200 ease-out`), smooth tab indicators, tactile button active states (`active:scale-[0.98]`)

layouts_and_grids.mobile_first: Default single-column stack on 375px/mobile browsers, responsive breakpoint expansion at md (768px) and lg (1024px+). Navigation transforms from sticky top glass bar with bottom sheet trigger to full desktop horizontal bar with avatar drop menu.
layouts_and_grids.dashboard_grid: Tetris-dense layout: Top 4-card metric strip (`grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4`), main section (`grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12`) with 8-col Recharts score timeline & recent sessions, 4-col Weak Area Focus & Daily Roadmap checklist.
layouts_and_grids.interview_room_grid: Split screen (`grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12`): 7-col Question & Answer interactive canvas, 5-col Real-Time Evaluation Rubric & Suggested Concepts panel.
layouts_and_grids.resume_analyzer_grid: Side-by-side (`grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12`): 4-col Document upload & extracted text viewer, 8-col Diagnostic breakdown (ATS score, keyword match, grammar & clarity recommendations).

motion.entrance_preset: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.25, ease: 'easeOut' }}
motion.recording_animation: animate-pulse with subtle radial ring wave for active microphone / voice simulation state

accessibility.contrast_standard: APCA & WCAG AA 4.5:1 strictly enforced across light and dark surfaces
accessibility.aria_labels: All icon-only buttons (close, copy, mic, sound, menu) must have explicit `aria-label`
accessibility.form_labels: All form controls use explicit Shadcn `Label` components paired via `htmlFor` and input `id`
accessibility.test_attributes: All clickable buttons, input fields, tabs, navigation links, and key status badges MUST provide unique `data-testid` attributes (e.g. `data-testid='start-mock-interview-button'`, `data-testid='resume-upload-dropzone'`)

instructions_to_main_agent: Theme and Styling: Implement the Navy (#0B132B) and Indigo (#4F46E5) with subtle Violet (#7C3AED) accents palette. The background is crisp slate (#F8FAFC) for daylight clarity and high focus.
Typography: Use Outfit for headings and Plus Jakarta Sans for body copy. Import them from `@fontsource-variable/outfit` and `@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans` in `src/index.css`.
Mobile Responsiveness: Mobile viewport (375px+) is primary. Ensure all tables, interview textareas, charts, and filter pills wrap cleanly and do not overflow horizontal bounds.
Testing Attributes: Add `data-testid` to every button, link, tab, input, select trigger, and modal close button.
Data Visualization: Use Recharts for the Readiness Trend over time and Domain Mastery radar/bar charts. Keep tooltips styled with navy background and white text.
AI Scoring Disclaimer: Always include the mandatory note 'AI scores are predictive estimates based on placement benchmarks' on all feedback cards and report banners.
